recovery.useRecoveryLink: Lost your device? Use a recovery code
recovery.intro: Emergency access: enter your username and one single-use recovery code. This starts a limited recovery flow (reset MFA enrollment), not a full console session.
recovery.adminLoginDistinctionNote: Phone-level enrollment validation is not the same as a completed admin login. Admin-security actions become available only after a successful admin sign-in is recorded.
recovery.recoveryCodeHint: 32 digits in eight groups. You may paste digits only; dashes are added automatically.
recovery.recoverFailed: Recovery failed. Check your username and code.
recovery.resetFailed: Could not reset enrollment. Try again or use another recovery code.
recovery.tokenExpired: Recovery session expired. Enter your details again.
recovery.tokenActiveBody: {{count}} recovery code(s) remaining for {{username}}. Reset your MFA enrollment to unbind the lost device and get new bind credentials.
recovery.resetSuccessBody: Your old device is unbound. Scan the QR code with the EZKey mobile app to bind your replacement device, or use manual entry below. Then sign in with passwordless login.
recovery.previewNotice: Technology preview: this screen shows the enrollment QR and binding challenge together for convenience. Ezkey does not automatically deliver email or SMS in this flow yet. A production-grade flow would deliver these through separate channels for stronger assurance. This hosted build is intended as a demonstrator, not a production security baseline.
recovery.qrHint: Open EZKey on your phone and scan this code to continue enrollment.
recovery.qrErrorBody: Use the binding challenge and manual enrollment proof token below, or try refreshing the page.
recovery.manualEntryHint: Use this if you cannot scan the QR. Enter the enrollment ID and proof token where your client expects them (e.g. demo app with Docker)—same binding payload as the QR. Keep confidential.
recovery.thenPasswordless: After binding your device, return here and use “Login with EZKey” as usual.

validation.codeFormat: Use 32 digits in the format XXXX-XXXX-…-XXXX (digits only is fine when pasting)

activation.useActivationLink: Have an activation code? Activate your account
activation.intro: First-time setup: enter the one-time activation code you received from an administrator. EZKey will create your first device enrollment and return the binding material needed to complete setup.
activation.adminLoginDistinctionNote: Completing device binding validates enrollment capability, but it does not by itself record a completed admin login.
activation.activateFailed: Activation failed. Check the code and try again.
activation.successBody: First-time setup is ready for {{username}}. Bind your first device now, then use the authenticated admin flow for recovery-code management.
activation.previewNoticeTitle: Security posture: bootstrap mode, not production-grade onboarding
activation.previewNotice: Technology preview: this screen shows the enrollment QR, binding challenge, and proof token together for bootstrap convenience. Ezkey does not automatically deliver email or SMS in this flow yet. A production-grade onboarding flow should deliver activation and binding material through controlled or separate channels. This hosted build is a demonstrator, not a production security baseline.
activation.recoveryCodesDeferredBody: Recovery codes are not created in this unauthenticated bootstrap step. Issue them later from an authenticated admin-management flow after the administrator has completed a first sign-in.
activation.qrHint: Open EZKey on your phone and scan this code to continue enrollment.
activation.qrErrorBody: Use the binding challenge and manual enrollment proof token below, or try refreshing the page.
activation.manualEntryHint: Use this if you cannot scan the QR. Enter the enrollment ID and proof token where your client expects them. Keep these values confidential.
activation.thenPasswordless: After binding your device, return here and use “Login with EZKey” as usual.

validation.codeFormat: Use an activation code in the format ezkey_activation_...
